scene_analysis.scene_overview: A street view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with parked motorcycles and outdoor seating areas for restaurants and cafes. The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. There are several trees planted along the sidewalk, some of which have lost their leaves. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street are multi-story apartment buildings with balconies and windows. They appear to be made of stone or concrete and have a mix of modern and traditional architectural styles. Some of the buildings have awnings over their entrances.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. There are also several large planters filled with greenery along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables outside the restaurants and cafes, as well as bike racks and trash cans.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are mostly bare, suggesting that it may be winter or early spring. There are also some plants and flowers growing in the planters.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including street signs, directional signs, and advertisements for local businesses.
scene_analysis.as_resident: Some residents seem to enjoy the area, while others may find it too loud or overwhelming. There are also some areas that are less populated, such as the alleyways and side streets.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The area is moderately walkable, with a mix of pedestrian-friendly and busy areas. There are some bike paths and bike racks, but not many cars are parked here.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: This area is popular with tourists who come to admire the architecture and take photos. There are also some local shops and cafes that cater to tourists.
